scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: IF EIBCALEN IS EQUAL TO ZERO -- EM-VARIABLE ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (it writes the message to TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

notes: GenApp's update-customer service (LGUCDB01, LINKed with the LGCMAREA COMMAREA, described by its caller LGUCUS01's record): UPDATE CUSTOMER sets every column from the COMMAREA by customer number, then LGUCVS01 (run in the same task) rewrites the VSAM copy. A customer that does not exist (+100, '01') leads LGUCVS01 to LINK LGSTSQ (below). A customer on KSDSCUST but not in Db2 (customer 11, ksdscust-vsam-only.txt) is the one +100 that does not reach LGSTSQ: LGUCVS01 finds the record. #4607 / X6 (owner decision): LGSTSQ runs in the same task ("programs"; "region" for its ASSIGN SYSID). An EIBCALEN-0 task (no-commarea) LINKs it with the short ERROR-MSG and ABENDs LGCA, compared whole (the WRITEQ TD and WRITEQ TS it writes too). An error path with the 32500-byte COMMAREA LINKs it a second time with the 99-byte CA-ERROR-MSG; LGSTSQ then writes 104 bytes from its 95-byte WRITE-MSG (X6), so that task is judged up to the refused WRITEQ: what it did before is compared, its end state is not. Not settled on z/OS (#4050). Still not reached: IF EIBCALEN < 91 true (a COMMAREA shorter than 91 bytes; the harness passes the case's whole COMMAREA).
